name: One real native spy return turn after the archived failed mission

condition.code: local p=Players[Game.GetLocalPlayer()]; return p and p:IsTurnActive() and type(ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary)=='table'

steps.code: local r=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_BOUNDARY_ENEMY_SPY_RETRY')); assert(r.current==2 and r.mode=='RETURN' and not r.missionRequested,'native living spy retry state changed'); assert(ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary.RetryLivingSpy()=='OFF_MAP_RETURN','spy has already returned; read the living roster before advancing'); return 'OFF_MAP_RETURN'
local b=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary; if b.RetryLivingSpy()=='ADOPTION_REQUIRED' then return b.TryAdoptReturnedSpy() end; return 'NO_ADOPTION'

condition.code: local a=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary.lastAction; if a=='UNKNOWN_RETRY_ADOPT' or a=='ERROR_RETRY_ADOPT' then error(a) end; return a=='IDLE' or a=='ACCEPTED_RETRY_ADOPT'
